sections.golden: Stored totals and base + bonus on payoff, certificates, summaries, copied results, exports and leaderboard; configured headline, single reduced-motion-safe shimmer and existing gold chime; gold frame, rules, labels, curve and accessible mobile marker; callout above Share.
sections.footer: Measure rendered text, shrink to a 14 px minimum, then elide the middle only if needed. Actual practice and production URLs fit without elision.
sections.answers: Owner answers on feed/story and consented summary/certificate links, with a shared remembered Hide my answers setting. Prepared images alone do not grant public consent. Struck guesses and other players remain excluded.
sections.zone: Filing date and time use the selected named zone; changing the zone regenerates prepared images. R19F edition dates remain game dates.
sections.images: 128 image checks in both themes; largest 305341 bytes.
sections.individual: Holder answer headline, stored score with bonus, readable rarity, mini curve and gold variant; non-holder unshared links stay sealed.
sections.samsung: Existing first-paint color-scheme and theme-color implementation verified with touch and force-dark; certificate pixels match normal rendering in Paper and Carbon.

loadTest.reason: Finished before the R12 7:05 PM ET practice-load window; R12 explicitly permits skipping instead of waiting. The local 200-arrival test passed.

limitations: Browser/device and Samsung Internet checks are emulations, not physical devices.
Native share payloads and activation use API stubs; actual practice downloads and links were exercised.
Production remains closed and has no fabricated test claims; its smoke test is read-only.
